question: Kareena starts from Point A and drives 16 km towards the east. She then takes a right turn, drives 7 km, turns right and drives 7 km. She then takes a left turn and drives 8 km. She takes a final right turn, drives 9 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should she drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified.)
